quote.text: We learn not in the school, but in life.
quote.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Encourage your children to embrace real-world experiences: allow them to learn from the trials and triumphs of everyday life, not just from textbooks or lectures.
    • Model a curious and reflective mindset; show that valuable lessons—about empathy, resilience, and growth—are often found in living and learning from our daily interactions.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that the most potent lessons in leadership arise from confronting real challenges; every obstacle offers an opportunity to grow wiser and more compassionate.
    • Foster an environment where learning happens continuously: celebrate both successes and failures as essential parts of the journey toward becoming a stronger leader.
  • Product Management
    • Embrace the idea that insights often come from engaging directly with users and the market—real-life feedback can guide more effective product strategies than theoretical models alone.
    • Adopt a mindset of iterative learning: use each product iteration and user interaction as an opportunity to refine and evolve your approach, recognizing that true education happens in practice.
